name: FPSO and floating production (TLP, spar, semi-submersible)
aliases: FPSO and floating production (TLP, spar, semi-submersible)
principle: A floating production, storage and offloading vessel processes, stores and offloads oil, usually moored by a turret; TLPs, spars and semi-submersibles host dry or wet trees in deeper water. Over 270 FPSOs were in service (a 2019 figure), and a new build can cost up to US$1 billion.
